title: kvox.transcript/v1
description: Public, versioned JSON export format for a KVox transcript. See docs/specs/transcription.md §8.2 for the full rationale. This schema is a contract with the outside world: a field is never removed or repurposed, only added — a breaking change ships as kvox.transcript/v2 with its own $id, and a v1 exporter keeps shipping v1 forever.

schema.description: Format identifier and version, always this literal string. A consumer should switch on this field rather than assume the shape of an unversioned JSON blob.

id.description: KVox's internal transcript id. Opaque to a consumer; useful only for round-tripping back into KVox.

language.description: BCP-47-ish language tag as reported by the provider (e.g. "en"), or null when language detection was not used and none was set.

version.description: The transcript_versions.version this export was materialized from. Version 1 is always the unedited AI original.

author.description: Who authored this version. Null for version 1 (kind: ai_original) and for a restore whose restored_from_version was itself the AI original.

createdAt.description: When the exported VERSION was created (transcript_versions.created_at), not when the export file was rendered.

exportedAt.description: When this export document was rendered.

provider.description: Which transcription provider produced the AI original. Null is not expected in practice (every transcript has one) but is legal so a hand-authored or fully-manual transcript created by a future import path is still valid against this schema.

model.description: The provider's own model/version identifier, when it reports one.

id.description: Stable within this transcript; a segment's speakerId refers back to this.

talkTimeMs.description: Sum of this speaker's segment durations, provided as a convenience — a consumer can always recompute it from segments.

wordsAlignment.description: Whether the word-level timings below are the provider's own, reconstructed by interpolation across an edit, or not meaningfully alignable (evenly spread as a last resort). See docs/specs/transcription.md §3.4.

words.description: Omitted, or an empty array, when the export options did not request word timings.

segments.text: Let's get started, thanks everyone for joining.
